backend_note: Core platform (build pipeline, hosting, dashboard, search, AI services) is proprietary SaaS — N/A for repo health. Health below covers the public repos actually inspected. GitHub API access was unavailable from this environment (session-scoped); stars/forks/issues were read from GitHub web pages via fetch on 2026-08-12, commit/contributor data from shallow+deepened git clones.

mintlify/docs.issue_activity: 86 open issues / 15 open PRs observed; triage cadence not measured
mintlify/docs.maintenance_assessment: Very actively maintained; heavy human+bot cadence; serves as vendor's dogfooding surface for agent workflows
